answer_1.quote: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) aims to automatically answer natural language questions via well-structured facts stored in Knowledge Graphs... adopt LLMs as the generator to reason for answers.

answer_2.quote: D-RAG employs Hits@1 and F1 metrics for evaluation on WebQSP and CWQ. The evaluation process first parses LLM-generated answers into a list for comparison with the ground truth answers.
